notes.title: RIBBY: THE GAME: THE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
After a lot of hurdles, the demo for my passion project, Ribby: The Game, has released! It would mean the world if you could check it out. 

-----

It's Ribby: The Game! An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about acceptance, friends, and frogs! Ribbit.

Follow the story of Ribecca "Ribby" Brown, an altruistic frog girl on a journey to get back home - hoping to make some friends along the way and discover things she doesn't yet know about herself.

Looking inward is always a daunting task, especially when you're afraid of what you'll find.

-----

[u][b]
Warning: This game may make you feel like:[/b][/u]

- Smiling
- Having fun
- Telling ALL of your friends about it
- Kissing someone right on the mouth

-----

Cover Art & BG by: https://twitter.com/grimoirekitty & https://twitter.com/figburn

thank you for checking out this goofy little page, and have a great day

[octolivvy]
